plugins.name: rig
plugins.description: Launch Claude Code with a named set of plugins, your local plugin checkouts pinned in, and the sandbox when you want it.

plugins.name: ClaudeWatch
plugins.description: Screens every shell command and every file Claude writes, before either lands. Blocks the dangerous, asks on anything that changes state.

plugins.name: shipshape
plugins.description: Know what's changing in your Claude Code harness and keep it current: every Claude Code upgrade handled, every plugin reconciled, updated, and pruned.

plugins.name: tack
plugins.description: Route tracker for AI-assisted development work (pivots, deliverables and dependencies) across session boundaries.

plugins.name: beacon
plugins.description: At-a-glance awareness across concurrent Claude Code sessions: a Claude Code status line, a CLI and browser dashboard on any terminal, and painted iTerm2 chrome.

plugins.name: anchor
plugins.description: One skill per step of the code-change lifecycle: file an issue, review the diff and commit, open and describe a change request, resolve review feedback, merge, release, and watch the pipeline. Supports multiple source forges (GitHub, GitLab).

plugins.name: mate
plugins.description: Fix and feature playbooks that start on their own when tack opens an issue.

plugins.name: cleat
plugins.description: Keep a repo's instructions in one AGENTS.md that every agent reads, with CLAUDE.md reduced to a pointer at it.

plugins.name: sextant
plugins.description: AI-assisted, best-effort spec-driven development: keep requirements in source control, track how the code covers them, reconcile the two either direction.

plugins.name: fathom
plugins.description: Keeps the facts of a piece of work in one versioned record and renders each reader's document from it, with every figure traced to a fact.

plugins.name: masthead
plugins.description: Bootstraps a documentation hub for a repo and keeps it current, on the docs engine you choose, so the people who come next can find how it works and what to watch out for.
